home.cloud_text: Hello and welcome! I’m a web developer focused on building modern websites and web applications using Laravel and the core technologies of the web. I enjoy creating clean, reliable systems and user-friendly interfaces that help bring ideas to life.

about.heading: About ⚡ Me
paragraphs: My name is Petros Skoulas, and I am a web developer from Greece. After completing my secondary education at the 9th General Lyceum of Amarousion, I pursued Information Technology (IT) studies at the American College of Greece – Deree, where I specialized in Software Development and graduated in 2020. During my studies, I developed a strong interest in web development and software systems, which led me to focus on building modern websites and web applications.

I work extensively with the core technologies of the web, including HTML, CSS/SCSS, and JavaScript, building clean, responsive interfaces and structured frontends. I prioritize simplicity and maintainability, applying JavaScript thoughtfully to enhance interactivity while keeping the overall system lightweight and easy to reason about.

My primary focus is backend-driven web development using PHP and Laravel. I build complete web applications, handling everything from data modeling and application logic to structured and responsive interfaces. I prioritize clean architecture, maintainable codebases, and solutions that are reliable and scalable over time.

I also work with WordPress as a development platform, focusing on custom theme development using both classic and modern block-based approaches. This includes Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), WooCommerce customization, and plugin development. I build structured, maintainable solutions with a strong understanding of both traditional PHP-based theming and modern block architecture, choosing the appropriate approach based on each project’s needs.

I am particularly interested in building clean, well-structured web applications and continuously improving my development workflow through real projects. My goal is to deliver reliable web solutions while constantly expanding my understanding of modern web development practices.

core_technologies.description: Laravel is the framework I currently focus on most for building modern backend-driven web applications. I enjoy its elegant architecture, expressive syntax, and the powerful tools it provides for developing maintainable systems. Through building real projects, including a custom CMS, I have gained practical experience with routing, controllers, Blade templating, database design with Eloquent ORM, authorization policies, validation, and application structure. Laravel allows me to build complete web systems with clear architecture and strong separation between application logic and presentation.

PHP is the core language behind much of the modern web, and it forms the foundation of my backend development work. My focus is on writing clean, structured PHP code while leveraging modern development practices. Working with Laravel has significantly deepened my understanding of PHP, including object-oriented programming, application architecture, and how backend systems interact with databases and web interfaces.

HTML is the fundamental building block of any website or web application. While its simplicity might cause some to overlook its importance, I deeply value its role in web development. I strive to write clean, semantic HTML that follows best practices, improving accessibility, maintainability, and technical SEO through well-structured markup.

CSS can be quirky (and occasionally frustrating), but it remains one of the most creative aspects of web development. I enjoy crafting clean layouts, responsive designs, and polished interfaces while keeping styles organized and maintainable. A solid understanding of CSS fundamentals allows me to build interfaces that are both visually appealing and technically sound.

As part of my styling workflow, I use the Sass preprocessor (.scss) to keep styles modular and maintainable. Features such as nesting, variables, and mixins help structure larger stylesheets more effectively while keeping the codebase easier to manage as projects grow.

JavaScript enables dynamic behavior and interactivity on the web. I primarily use it to enhance user interfaces and improve user experience through DOM manipulation, event handling, and asynchronous requests. In many projects I prefer lightweight solutions, such as Alpine.js, which integrate well with server-rendered applications.

WordPress remains the most widely used content management system on the web, and I have experience working within its ecosystem when projects require it. I am comfortable with custom theme development, the template hierarchy, hooks, custom fields, custom post types, custom taxonomies, and custom queries. I also have experience with WooCommerce customization and a solid understanding of how WordPress can be extended to meet specific client requirements.

Earlier in my development journey I explored React and gained experience with its component-based architecture, JSX syntax, and hooks. While my current focus has shifted toward backend-driven applications using Laravel, my familiarity with React helped strengthen my understanding of modern JavaScript development and frontend component architecture.

workflow_tools.description: In almost every project I've worked on, I've used NPM via the command line to manage workflow tools like Webpack, Parcel, and Vite, as well as various project-specific dependencies. This hands-on experience has helped me develop a deep understanding of these tools and their impact on development efficiency. By mastering them, I've honed my ability to produce clean, optimized code that adheres to industry standards.

Like every developer should, I’ve immersed myself in version control with Git and GitHub, understanding their crucial role in modern software development. Through consistent use, I’ve gained proficiency in the fundamentals, allowing me to navigate repositories, track changes, and collaborate seamlessly. By harnessing the full potential of Git and GitHub, I ensure efficient teamwork, maintain clear version histories, and keep code changes organized across all my projects.

college_education.description: During my university studies I had the opportunity to work with the Django framework in Python as part of a capstone project, where I built a basic content management system. This experience introduced me to key backend development concepts such as MVC-style architecture, database interaction, and server-side application design. Although my current focus is primarily on PHP and Laravel, working with Django helped strengthen my understanding of backend web development and web application architecture.

Database design and data management are essential parts of modern web applications. Through both my academic studies and practical development work, I have developed a solid understanding of SQL databases, relational data modeling, and query design. In my current projects, particularly with Laravel and Eloquent ORM, I regularly work with database structures, migrations, and queries to build reliable and well-structured application backends.

During my academic journey, I engaged in a wide variety of software development projects, including web applications, mobile apps, desktop software, and even video games. These experiences exposed me to multiple programming languages and environments such as Java, C, C#, Android Studio, Python, PHP, and JavaScript. By working hands-on with these diverse technologies, I strengthened my skills and versatility as a developer, equipping myself to face a broad range of challenges in the constantly evolving tech landscape.
